[[[null,["b46fa0cd-d34f-49c8-92e4-76f74ca6e74a",["1773706975",7260000],["1773663755",205136000],["workflow pod controller",null,"Design a kiosk tablet UI (1280x800 landscape, 10.1" screen) for a silence pod booking display. 
                                                                                                                                                                                                   
  Layout                                                                                                                                                                                           

  Top Status Bar (full width, 40dp height):
  - Left: App name "Chamber Pod" + Device ID "SILENCE-POD-0001"
  - Center: Current time (HH:mm)
  - Right: Temperature "25°C", Humidity "45%", presence indicator (green dot), settings gear icon

  Main Content (two-column split):

  Left Column (55% width):

  Pod Banner Card at top:
  - Pod name: "Silence Pod A3"
  - Floor 2, Location: "Building B, Zone 3"
  - Capacity: 4 people (icon + text)
  - Status badge: green "Available" or red "In Use"

  Upcoming Bookings List below banner (scrollable):
  - Each booking card shows:
    - Time range bold: "14:00 - 15:00"
    - Meeting title: "Sprint Planning"
    - "Booked by: John Nguyen"
    - "Participants: 3" with people icon
  - Currently active meeting card has a highlighted blue left border
  - Show 3-4 booking cards in the list
  - If no bookings, show empty state: "No upcoming bookings"

  Right Column (45% width):

  Current Meeting Panel (large, prominent):
  - Header: "Current Meeting" label
  - Large meeting title: "Sprint Planning"
  - "Booked by: John Nguyen"
  - Time: "14:00 - 15:00"
  - Countdown: "45 min remaining" in accent color
  - Large QR code (200x200dp) centered, on a white square background for contrast
  - Text below QR: "Scan to check in"

  Quick Controls Row at bottom of right column:
  - 3-4 circular icon buttons in a row: Light bulb, Fan, Lock, Desk
  - Each toggleable with on/off state (blue when on, gray when off)

  Bottom Navigation Bar (full width, 48dp):
  - Two tabs: "Bookings" (calendar icon, active/highlighted) and "Controls" (sliders icon, inactive)

  Style Notes

  - Material 3 dark theme, rounded corners (12dp) on all cards
  - Card borders: subtle #3A3A3A
  - Clean, minimal, no gradients
  - Monospace or sans-serif font
  - This is a kiosk display meant to be viewed from standing distance

  Generate a high-fidelity mockup of this screen",null,"default",null,"1507",1],1,[1,1,1]]]],"AUBbQtYcRwfGKrWAExNRaXWaYfmz0q3+EmP+Jq+jRwo+w/5Gx/1HIEJWSjLIsGF/esxWTruYzytmelQWEjk1+SxThr+GmsF2Y3HtmSm14/FGiLMnj8+eyEt6tC8f0bIPxZ1R813NWUdDAR/mlpAJ71C2xDpFkLfr95x3lTV19QuCsNPV"]
